inserted.description: Array of new elements; i.e. ones that are in a new collection but not in an old collection.

updated.description: Array of updated elements; i.e. ones from new collection that existed in the old one and contain different values.

updatedOld.description:
Array of old copy of updated elements; i.e. ones from the old collection that are updated in the new one. Note that
size of this array matches updated and objects are in the same order as in updated.

removed.description: Array of old elements; i.e. ones that were in the old collection but not in new one.

name: CollectionUpdate
